description: Source-qualified alternate processor roles. Members are mutually exclusive alternatives, never simultaneous CPU requirements. Applied only to existing native primary-CPU gates.

groups.label: 8086 compatible CPU
groups.qualification: Matching 40-pin 8086 DIP pinout, supply, minimum/maximum bus mode and system clock grade. The selected PS/2 Model 30 uses an 8 MHz 8086-2-class profile.

evidence.note: AMD manufacturer data book, printed 2-104 onward: AMD 8086 ordering, pinout and electrical/bus specifications; compare Intel 8086 family manual.

groups.note: Compatible substitute candidate for the matching CPU role, not an original factory-BOM claim or verified physical installation. Later AMD parts may follow the original host date.

groups.label: 8088 compatible CPU
groups.qualification: Matching 40-pin 8088 DIP pinout, 8-bit external data bus, supply, bus mode and host clock grade. An 8086 is not a physical substitute.

evidence.note: AMD manufacturer data book, printed 2-136 onward: AMD 8088 ordering, connection diagram and bus specifications.

groups.note: Compatible substitute candidate for the matching CPU role, not an original factory-BOM claim or verified physical installation. Later AMD parts may follow the original host date.

groups.label: 80286 compatible CPU
groups.qualification: Match the specific 68-pin package/socket, board voltage and clock/timing grade; PGA and leadless-carrier packages are separate physical choices.

evidence.note: AMD 1985 manufacturer sheet: package choices, connection diagrams and 6/8/10 MHz speed options.

groups.note: Compatible substitute candidate for the matching CPU role, not an original factory-BOM claim or verified physical installation. Later AMD parts may follow the original host date.

groups.label: 386DX compatible CPU
groups.qualification: Use the matching 132-pin DX package and 5 V board timing profile. Match socket/package, clock, chipset, cache and BIOS; DX and SX are different pinouts.

evidence.note: AMD Am386DX manufacturer sheet: compatible implementation of Intel i386DX; original 132-pin package/connection and electrical specifications.

groups.note: Compatible substitute candidate for the matching CPU role, not an original factory-BOM claim or verified physical installation. Later AMD parts may follow the original host date.

groups.label: 386SX compatible CPU
groups.qualification: Use the original 5 V Am386SX in the matching 100-lead PQFP profile and qualify the host clock/timing. Do not infer compatibility for every SXL/SXLV/low-voltage member or IBM 386SLC.

evidence.note: AMD March 1991 Rev A, page 1 explicitly identifies Am386SX as a pin-for-pin Intel i386SX replacement.

groups.note: Compatible substitute candidate for the matching CPU role, not an original factory-BOM claim or verified physical installation. Later AMD parts may follow the original host date.
